name: ch4_fig22_moma_projection
prompt: Title (top): "WT 기준에서 가장 가까운 돌연변이 상태" + smaller warm-grey "MOMA Proximity". Draw a clean 2D conceptual plot with completely unlabeled horizontal and vertical axes. One blue rounded feasible polygon is labeled "돌연변이 가능 상태". One purple point outside is labeled "WT 기준". One orange point exactly on the polygon boundary is labeled "MOMA" and connects directly to the WT point by a single straight shortest dashed line labeled "변화 거리"; do not place any extra point on that line. One green star at a different location on the polygon boundary is labeled "FBA". Use red emphasis only on the dashed distance. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: the polygon, points, star, and line have perfectly uniform solid fills or strokes. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no coordinates, values, captions, proof text, or other labels.
